limitations: The81-case and84-case suites test the complete serialized grammar and selected local semantic counterexamples,not a scientific runtime or full foreign-key/cost recomputation engine. Full normative semantic predicates remain binding for future implementation.

Root discovered andfixed an allocation-scenario subset inconsistency while integrating the unsealed draft: selection-score scenarios are global per candidate,with strata derived from endpoint targets. No partial version was released orarchived.
The strict numeric profile is mandatory in addition to JSON Schema. jsonschemaDraft2020-12 accepts integral floats; three final cases verify the application rejects those encodings in integer fields.
Two81-case passes preceded the committed prospective allowance amendment; the final84-case pass followed it. No test was deleted to fit the old cap andno prior count was rewritten.
No fixture/curve,scientific null/control/timing panel,Sage/PARI,signature,key,nonce,lock,RUN orfuture pipeline was invoked.
Memory compliance is based on observed RSS,not a claimed installed virtual-address-space limit. SIGALRM guarded each fixed case.
The package requires exact snapshot andfresh independent complete-definition review before any protocol orimplementation approval.
